meaning:
τραυματίζω
(τραῦμα), [in LXX chiefly for חָלַל ;]
to wound: Luk.20:12, Act.19:16.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.
The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.
